findings.fix: State the content directly: `have hne : volume.restrict (Icc tLo tHi) ≠ 0 := by rw [Measure.restrict_eq_zero, Real.volume_Icc]; simp [sub_pos.mpr h]` then `haveI := ae_neBot.mpr hne` and finish with `exact hfalse.exists.elim fun _ hx => hx`, using only `MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_eq_zero` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Restrict.lean:237), `MeasureTheory.ae_neBot` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Filter.lean:44) and `Filter.Eventually.exists` (Mathlib/Order/Filter/Basic.lean:814).
findings.issue: `simp only [ae_iff, not_false_eq_true, ofPred_true, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Icc, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero] at hfalse` + `linarith` closes `False` by depending on the exact normal form of `∀ᵐ _t ∂volume.restrict (Icc tLo tHi), False`; the glue lemmas it needs are set/filter internals (`ofPred_true` was `setOf_true` until the 2026-07-09 rename, see Mathlib/Data/Set/Basic.lean:570), and the reader cannot see that the real content is `volume (Icc tLo tHi) ≠ 0`. The same internals dependence appears at line 244 (`simp only [not_imp, not_not, mem_ofPred_eq] at ht`), though there it only destructures a negated implication.

summary: Proofs are short, explicit, and free of defeq manipulation; the helper `abs_eq_of_normalizedExpProfile_eq` is correctly factored out. One proof closes a goal by simp-normalizing the internal shape of `∀ᵐ x, False` into an arithmetic inequality, which is fragile and hides the actual reason (the restricted measure is nonzero).
